why: ChatGPT answered with one product type, a power station sized by watt-hours (10–30 W LED strings need about 200–300 Wh, and 50 W for 6 hours needs about 400 Wh after inverter losses), and its weather warning names no accessory the shopper must buy. Getting the capacity right is what matters, and the lights plug straight into the station's AC outlets, so this calls for a page that compares models and recommends one, not a kit.
